channel.title: Fixture Long
channel.description: RSS fixture with a teaser longer than two lines

item.title: A post with a long teaser
item.description: This teaser is deliberately long. It keeps going well past the two lines that a card shows, even on a wide desktop screen, so the reader needs a way to see the rest of it without opening the article. The last words of this teaser are the proof that it works: the end is visible.
